enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Sonic Lore VI: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Resonance +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Wailing: Shrieking weapons emit a haunting wail whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This wail deals an additional 3 to 18 sonic damage.
Stunning +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
